resources.string:
1. Stop the server. You can only change your spawn location while the server is stopped.

2. Tap “Map teleport” and choose All areas, Calyx-supported areas, or Exploration-only areas.

3. Choose a world and an area. Check the Scene ID, map layer, spawn coordinates, and description, then tap “Teleport.”

4. Go back to the main screen and start the server, then reconnect to the game. Your new spawn location is loaded when the server starts, so this will not move a character who is already in the game.

Map teleport only changes the scene section in persistent.json. Before making a change, the app saves your previous settings as persistent.json.bak. Each new change replaces the previous backup. To restore a backup, stop the server and restore the file with a file manager.

Calyx-supported areas include the data needed for Calyx combat. In exploration-only areas, the Calyx is moved out of bounds to prevent accidental interaction and endless loading. Use the CN/EN button in the top-right corner to switch the interface, area names, and descriptions.
